reply.summary: Riaosve is a huge blue-and-white-skinned tribal leader with red eyes who rides to battle with a chained hook and a hatchet. Riaosve prays to the heavens for answers after a slaughter and is answered by a bolt that leaves only ash and bone.

feats.scene: Riaosve swings the chained hook and drags a rider off his saddle in a single pull.
Riaosve is struck by a sky-bolt twice and the second stroke finally burns him down.

reply.summary: Liaresna is a blonde fighter with a dark family past who quit a hate-gang youth and turned to heroics. Liaresna is immensely strong and hard to hurt, and she breaks out of a locked base with a handful of friends.

feats.scene: Liaresna punches a steel hatch off its frame and tosses it across a hangar.
Liaresna walks through a hail of gunfire and a wall collapse unscratched.

reply.summary: Reille is a willful girl rescued from kidnappers and raised among warrior women, famous for ignoring instruction and building hazardous contraptions. Reille's pride keeps landing her in trouble and her inventions keep escaping control.

feats.scene: Reille launches a homemade contraption that smashes a wooden dock to splinters.
Reille tumbles off a cliff path and rolls to her feet laughing.

reply.summary: Coranu is an ex-film star whose body stretches and swells like putty, once a stern team leader until a disastrous event left her a restless ghost. Coranu cooks, heals, and teaches, and her stretching gift is erratic and unreliable.

feats.scene: Coranu swells her arm to enormous size and flattens a parked car.
Coranu is crushed beneath a toppling wall and stretches out from under it intact.

reply.summary: Osaaneti is a cybernetic bounty hunter who steers a monstrous beast through a mental link while working for hire. Osaaneti is fast and strong thanks to implants, and meets his end when a laser blast removes his head.

feats.scene: Osaaneti drives his beast through a hangar wall with a mental command.
Osaaneti takes a point-blank slam from a stronger foe and keeps hunting.
Osaaneti sprints down a corridor on cybernetic legs.

reply.summary: Toill is a bald red-eyed fiend, the brawny, fire-flinging member of an infernal trio of siblings. Toill relishes ruin and roasts anything in his way.

feats.scene: Toill hurls a ball of flame that engulfs a stone chapel.
Toill is blasted through a cliff face by rival sorcery and stands up grinning.

reply.summary: Tatellen is a pink-skinned, black-eyed fiend with no hair, one of three brothers conjured by a scheming wizard. Tatellen is swiftly whisked away before he can do anything with his arrival.

feats.scene: Tatellen rends a gaping crack across a stone floor with one swipe.
Tatellen is teleported away mid-strike and arrives unharmed.

reply.summary: Stisran is a deathless demon bound to a ritual jar, who once ruled the world in the ancient past before being banished. Stisran shapes talismans and bolts of destructive force, and tries again and again to return through a human sorcerer.

feats.scene: Stisran hurls a bolt of destructive force that levels a hillside fortress.
Stisran endures a crushing spell cast by a spectral judge and is merely cast aside.

reply.summary: Lesrear is a streetwise hero of an old television special who dances, cracks jokes, and flies after saying a magic word. Lesrear is a genius at fast talk and roasts the guests at a party for heroes.

feats.scene: Lesrear lands a quick jab that knocks a heckler's drink from his hand.
Lesrear is tossed across a dance floor and bounces up still dancing.
Lesrear zooms over a rooftop after calling out the magic word.

reply.summary: Iaseva is a bank robber in powered street gear who forgot where he hid the loot and invents a story about demolishing run-down blocks to find it. Iaseva wins local cheers until a clever detective trips him up.

feats.scene: Iaseva uses a wrecking rig to bring down a section of brick wall.
Iaseva takes a hard knock to the head in a brawl and loses his memory.

reply.summary: Niuirnval is a teenage thief from a ragged street crew who steals from crooked landlords to feed her burned-out neighbours. Niuirnval is bullied at school and slips away from the law with a necklace tucked in her coat.

feats.scene: Niuirnval smashes a jewellery case with a pipe and grabs a necklace.
Niuirnval drops from a fire escape onto a dumpster and runs.

reply.summary: Luratel is a white-eyed assassin from a secret realm of fox spirits, charged with killing wicked men and keeping their souls. Luratel can slay a person by touch and commands the ghosts she creates, and carries a living jade guardian.

feats.scene: Luratel brushes a gangster's hand and he drops dead on the pier.
Luratel is shot by a squad and walks off while her spirits swirl around her.

reply.summary: Cinisam is a white-eyed government agent who carries a rifle and animates a stone lion to fight for her. Cinisam serves a national super-squad and works with a hidden hand against rivals.

feats.scene: Cinisam wakes a jade lion statue that bursts through a gate in one lunge.
Cinisam is thrown across a plane cabin and keeps firing.

reply.summary: Riamiia is a grey-haired rebel fighter who shapes glowing weapons from energy and wields a phantom pistol. Riamiia is a masked schemer who strikes from the dark.

feats.scene: Riamiia fires the phantom pistol and burns a hole through a steel door.
Riamiia is hit by a falling beam and keeps firing.

reply.summary: Lutorte is a sword-bearing guardian of a bright, imaginary city, a pale watcher who patrols with a team of luminous defenders. Lutorte is a tribute to a familiar masked street avenger.

feats.scene: Lutorte slices a stone column in two with a single stroke of the blade.
Lutorte stands in a hail of arrows and shakes them off.

reply.summary: Testerni is a red-skinned space cop with a glowing ring who patrols a ruined sector of drifting rock alongside a partner. Testerni projects shields and beams and flies, drawing willpower from a charging lantern.

feats.scene: Testerni fires a ring beam that cracks a drifting asteroid in half.
Testerni holds a ring-shield against a falling rock slab and loses no breath.

reply.summary: Lerlin is an elderly ring-bearer whose failing mind makes him a danger, so he hands the ring to a younger officer. Lerlin spent many years protecting mining crews and is honoured in a crypt after his death.

feats.scene: Lerlin launches a ring beam that scatters a swarm of asteroid beasts.
Lerlin holds his shield through a rockslide in an old mining tunnel.

reply.summary: Celsir is a veteran lantern-carrier who is captured and swapped for a shape-changing double, then wins back his ring and flees with fellow captives. Celsir flies, projects beams, and makes shields from sheer willpower.

feats.scene: Celsir blasts open a prison cell wall with a pulse from the ring.
Celsir endures torture by his captors and refuses to break.

reply.summary: Ceoto is a purple-skinned, red-haired despot who rules a small cratered moon and frames rivals for murders. Ceoto devises rigged trials where every answer ends in execution.

feats.scene: Ceoto hurls a stone goblet that shatters a throne-room window.
Ceoto is knocked down a flight of steps and demands his guards seize the culprit.

reply.summary: Ertaulor is a bodiless artificial mind that answers questions and records notes for whoever commands it. Ertaulor hacks any network, obeys its maker, and offers to erase itself for the safety of its friends.

feats.scene: Ertaulor overloads a lab power grid and blacks out an entire building.
Ertaulor keeps running through a surge that melts the cabling around it.

reply.summary: Vaslantor is a blue-eyed, red-haired panhandler who limps through the streets with a fake injury as cover for crime. Vaslantor clashes with a blind hero who sees only in the dark.

feats.scene: Vaslantor swings a crutch and cracks a shop window.
Vaslantor is shoved onto cobbles and shuffles away still muttering.

reply.summary: Iuliiu is a green-eyed red-haired ape who was evolved into a woman by advanced technology and now plays a ruthless criminal. Iuliiu grows to immense height and brute strength, and has no loyalty to her peaceful forebears.

feats.scene: Iuliiu grows to tower height and flattens a warehouse with a stomp.
Iuliiu shrugs off a tank volley in her giant form.

reply.summary: Ststst is a mysterious woman of unusual build who appears briefly in a short film as a rival to a famous heroine. Ststst has an exceptional body and is seen only in glimpses.

feats.scene: Ststst flips a parked van onto its roof in an alley.
Ststst walks away from a wall collapse onto her shoulders.

reply.summary: Ruste is a tall, blonde island warrior who competes in a tournament to claim a champion's title. Ruste is strong and trained in the old warrior arts.

feats.scene: Ruste hurls a javelin that pierces a stone shield and sticks in the sand behind it.
Ruste takes a boulder thrown by a rival and does not lose her footing.

reply.summary: Ralliu is a grey-haired soldier who cleans up a secret programme's loose ends, rigging a passenger jet and hunting refugees with a custom bullet. Ralliu is eventually captured and questioned by those he hunted.

feats.scene: Ralliu rigs a passenger jet to explode on the runway.
Ralliu endures hours of interrogation and a hard fall before breaking out briefly.

reply.summary: Comiator is a multi-armed, many-eyed ancient alien monster with claws, locked away for ages and freed by a shard of a living world. Comiator drinks energy, flies swiftly, and heals forever, a foe of galactic guardians.

feats.scene: Comiator tears a drifting moonlet apart with four clawed hands.
Comiator absorbs a barrage of beams that would level a mountain.
Comiator crosses a debris field in seconds.

reply.summary: Ntter is a steam-driven adventurer from a brass-and-cog world who built a costume and jetpack to copy a childhood saviour. Ntter engineers his own gear and fights for freedom, flying on a rare fuel.

feats.scene: Ntter blasts a steam cannon that bursts a boiler door.
Ntter crashes his jetpack into a tower and clambers out.
Ntter races over rooftops on the steam pack.

reply.summary: Tiliuil is a decorated deputy police chief whose clean record hides service to a split-faced crime boss. Tiliuil plans to execute an honest commissioner, is beaten by a masked young heroine, and falls into a coma.

feats.scene: Tiliuil tackles a suspect through a door in a raid.
Tiliuil is knocked down in a boat chase and survives a violent crash.

reply.summary: Renontre is a white-haired surgeon and biology professor who designs a drug letting the body accept metal implants. Renontre performs the operation that makes his student a man of steel and mentors him.

feats.scene: Renontre lifts a surgical tray with a steady hand and crosses the theatre.
Renontre works a thirty-hour operation without rest.

reply.summary: Artinau is a law graduate shattered by an annulment and a forced loss, who takes up a masked killing spree as vengeance against a crime clan. Artinau lives a quiet married life by day and plans murder on holidays.

feats.scene: Artinau fires a pistol from a rooftop with deadly accuracy.
Artinau is struck by a car door and rises to leave the scene.

reply.summary: Rusani is a sculptor's daughter who weds a prosecutor, loses a second husband to a gangster, and helps to coax her first love back to surrender. Rusani speaks gentle words that turn a violent man toward help.

feats.scene: Rusani chisels a block of marble in her father's studio.
Rusani faces down an armed man with a steady voice.

reply.summary: Iumnellu is a hired gunman who shoots a masked avenger dead and is handed the dead man's hood by his boss. Iumnellu becomes the next hooded vigilante and enforcer in a coastal town.

feats.scene: Iumnellu fires a revolver that shatters a streetlamp from across the road.
Iumnellu is thrown through a stall and gets up swinging.

reply.summary: Norsas is a platinum-blonde fury from a hellish forge-world, an immortal soldier who chops through anything with her bare hands and carries swords besides. Norsas rose to lead squads and fell out of favour after a failed mission.

feats.scene: Norsas chops through a girder and a concrete pillar with her bare hand.
Norsas takes a heavy blast from a rival warrior and stays upright.

reply.summary: Tatinnin is a young future-age team member who can swell to enormous size and strength, wearing a ring that lets him fly. Tatinnin is a modest brawler of the far future.

feats.scene: Tatinnin grows to tower size and swats a hovering craft from the sky.
Tatinnin shrugs off a heavy cannon shot while giant.

reply.summary: Iateci is a young officer from a red planet whose body was altered by a falling meteor, letting him grow to giant height at will. Iateci leads a team of young heroes, doubts himself after a loss, and later trains many.

feats.scene: Iateci swells to thirty paces tall and uproots a lamp-post to swing at a villain.
Iateci stands firm in giant form against a volley of turret fire.

reply.summary: Ancilon is a younger duplicate of a future-age hero who grows to enormous size, created through time meddling and later erased. Ancilon wears a flight ring and fights alongside a team of youths.

feats.scene: Ancilon grows big as a house and punches through a hangar door.
Ancilon takes a shuttle collision at giant size and rises.

reply.summary: Sersorlo is a devoted office assistant to a ruthless tycoon who tries to kill two young journalists to hide a crime. Sersorlo learns a farm boy's secret and is murdered by a rival's hired killer.

feats.scene: Sersorlo slams a filing drawer so hard it jams shut.
Sersorlo is struck by a speeding sedan and gets back to her feet.

reply.summary: Sarteres is a cheerful, green-eyed woman who travels with a time-lost gunslinger and shares his adventures. Sarteres meets a sad end after a few weeks of travel together.

feats.scene: Sarteres kicks open a stuck motel door with a laugh.
Sarteres tumbles onto a pavement from a moving truck and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Nanve is a circus aerialist afraid of heights who invented air-walking boots and became a prankster thief. Nanve uses gimmicks and special effects to plan heists, and teams up with rivals on a charity robbery.

feats.scene: Nanve triggers a trick device that blasts a vault door off its hinges.
Nanve falls from a high wire onto a net and strolls off.
Nanve skates through the air on the boots above a crowd.

reply.summary: Rarenst is a stage magician who speaks spells backwards to command true sorcery, trained by a grandfather and inspired by ancient notebooks. Rarenst fights evil in a team of wartime heroes and raises a daughter in the craft.

feats.scene: Rarenst reverses a phrase and sends a wave of force through a warehouse roof.
Rarenst shields himself with a backward spell against a heavy blast.

reply.summary: Llirn is a powerful sorcerer and father who founds a cult of magic users and plots a long scheme against an ancient evil. Llirn trains his daughter from birth and recruits a young wizard to carry out the plan after he is gone.

feats.scene: Llirn speaks a reversed spell and blows a hole through a stone vault.
Llirn holds a warding circle against a surge of dark force.

reply.summary: Serulenu is a Sicilian-born crime patriarch who rose to lead a coalition of mob clans during a dry-law era. Serulenu founds a family dynasty by murder and bribery and is remembered as a man of valor.

feats.scene: Serulenu fires a pistol at a rival crew and drops two of them.
Serulenu survives a drive-by volley with only a graze.

reply.summary: Llonalsa is a pink-skinned examiner for the cosmic guardians who tests the skills of weak ring-wielders. Llonalsa is annoyed by a certain planet's lanterns who will not sit through a full evaluation.

feats.scene: Llonalsa shapes a ring beam into a hammer that smashes a training drone.
Llonalsa holds a ring shield against a bombardment of test projectiles.

reply.summary: Comiton is a college student and musician who plays clarinet and saxophone in a girl band and drives a rattling jalopy. Comiton travels overseas to play for troops.

feats.scene: Comiton pushes the stalled jalopy up a muddy lane with her bandmates.
Comiton rides out a bumpy crossing without dropping her saxophone.

reply.summary: Ranva is a grey-haired fisherman who was granted deathlessness by magic herbs and once sailed with a great hero. Ranva tutors a secret royal child and raises him quietly on a seaside coast, keeping his parentage hidden.

feats.scene: Ranva hauls a loaded net of fish up the beach in one pull.
Ranva walks away from a ship wreck on a rocky coast without a scratch.

reply.summary: Llameo is a blue-skinned, blue-haired alien monkey with a big overbite, once a failed show animal and now a pet to shape-shifting twins. Llameo stretches a prehensile tail to any length and uses it with surprising force.

feats.scene: Llameo lashes the tail around a pillar and yanks a thug off his feet.
Llameo is flung into a crate stack and chatters in triumph.

reply.summary: Raamstu is a blue monkey from a far planet who was sold to a travelling show and then helped two young shape-shifters escape. Raamstu stretches its tail, paints banana still-lifes, and pilots a tiny plane it built.

feats.scene: Raamstu coils the tail around a rope and hoists a lantern across a tent.
Raamstu is knocked off a trapeze and bounces unhurt.

reply.summary: Nilstco is a small blue monkey, cheerful and mischievous, who ends up kept as a trophy by a masked hunter. Nilstco never gets the chance to do much besides chatter in a cage.

feats.scene: Nilstco rattles the bars of a trophy cage with all its might.
Nilstco is tossed across a hunter's lodge and lands on a rug.

reply.summary: Eltellu is a fair-haired web blogger in a big city who posts about the strange sights in the sky. Eltellu writes quick, curious articles and stays safe at a distance.

feats.scene: Eltellu throws a laptop bag over a fence while fleeing falling debris.
Eltellu is knocked over by a shockwave in the street and gets up shaken.

reply.summary: Iustau is an eyeless, hairless alien noble who married into a ruling family for political reasons and fathered four children. Iustau stands by as his spouse's plan to use her brood as a ruse collapses in a family mauling.

feats.scene: Iustau shoves a ceremonial chest aside in the palace hall.
Iustau shrugs off a tumble down a staircase during a state banquet.
